full_judgment: 6. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, the learned Advocate-on-Record, appearing for the petitioners, submits that the High Court Division failed to consider that the complainant-respondent herein had no title and possession in the disputed land and that the documents filed by the respondents including certified copy of the final decree passed in the Partition Suit No. 6 of 1981 for permanent injunction obtained by the father of the 2nd party and there is joint possession of land of the parties within the disputed land. He further submits that the proceeding under Section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure can not be maintained pending disposal of civil suit and as such the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division is liable to be set aside for the ends of justice. He lastly submits that the High Court Division failed to discuss the evidence of leave petitioners under its true perspective and as such the judgment and order passed by the High Court Division is not sustainable in law.
